encode_string_to_byte_chars: encode a string to byte-level characters by normalizing whitespace and mapping each UTF-8 byte to a unique character
decode_byte_chars_to_string: decode a string of byte-level characters back to the original UTF-8 string
smart_decode_with_recovery: smart decode byte-level characters with dynamic programming recovery when standard decoding fails
test_byte_encode_decode_roundtrip: test that byte_encode and byte_decode roundtrip correctly for a given input string
review_byte_encoding_constants: review the PRINTABLE_LATIN set and BYTE_TO_BCHAR mapping used for byte-level character encoding
